prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: chasing a contractor for repairs. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a contractor promises an attendance date, I chase it the same day if the member has no firm booking in writing, because repairs slip fastest evidence."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a contractor says they are waiting on parts or materials, I note the exact item and expected delivery window, because a proper chase is more useful than
